name: Law Enforcement
description: A police department with divisions, patrol units, law enforcement ranks, commendations, and certifications.

specialties.name: Special Weapons and Tactics
specialties.description: Tactical team trained in high-risk warrant service, hostage rescue, barricaded subjects, and active threat response.

specialties.name: Crisis Negotiation Team
specialties.description: Specialty team trained to communicate with subjects in crisis, hostage takers, and barricaded individuals to achieve peaceful resolution.

specialties.name: K9 Unit
specialties.description: Handlers and canines certified for patrol, narcotics, explosives detection, or tracking and apprehension operations.

specialties.name: Criminal Investigations
specialties.description: Plain-clothes investigators assigned to follow-up investigations of person and property crimes, narcotics, and major cases.

specialties.name: Traffic Enforcement Unit
specialties.description: Specialized traffic enforcement, crash reconstruction, and DUI interdiction.

specialties.name: School Resource Officer
specialties.description: Sworn officers assigned to public school campuses for safety, mentorship, and law enforcement liaison duties.

specialties.name: Marine Patrol
specialties.description: Waterborne patrol and rescue operations, including boating safety enforcement and dive recovery support.

specialties.name: Drone / sUAS Operator
specialties.description: FAA Part 107 certified operators flying small unmanned aircraft systems for tactical, search, and crash reconstruction support.

awards.name: Medal of Honor
awards.description: The department's highest honor, awarded for an act of conspicuous bravery performed at imminent and personal risk of life with full knowledge of the risks involved.

awards.name: Medal of Valor
awards.description: Awarded for an act of bravery performed in the line of duty at significant personal risk that goes beyond the expected scope of duty.

awards.name: Purple Heart
awards.description: Awarded to officers who sustain serious physical injury as a result of a felonious, unlawful act committed against them in the line of duty.

awards.name: Lifesaving Medal
awards.description: Awarded to officers whose direct and decisive actions are responsible for saving a human life, including CPR, water rescue, or applied tourniquet care.

awards.name: Distinguished Service Medal
awards.description: Awarded for sustained meritorious service or a single act of significant achievement that brings substantial credit to the department.

awards.name: Meritorious Service Award
awards.description: Recognizes exceptional performance of duty in a specific incident or assignment that exceeds normally expected service.

awards.name: Community Policing Award
awards.description: Awarded to officers whose sustained engagement, problem-solving, and partnership with community members produces measurable improvements in public safety.

awards.name: Officer of the Year
awards.description: Annual department honor recognizing the sworn member whose overall performance, professionalism, and leadership best represent the agency throughout the calendar year.

qualifications.name: POST Basic Law Enforcement Academy
qualifications.description: State Peace Officer Standards and Training basic academy certification, the prerequisite for sworn law enforcement service.

qualifications.name: Field Training Program (FTO)
qualifications.description: Successful completion of the department's phased FTO program, qualifying the officer for solo patrol assignment.

qualifications.name: Firearms Qualification - Duty Handgun
qualifications.description: Annual day and low-light qualification with the assigned duty handgun, performed under the supervision of a certified firearms instructor.

qualifications.name: Patrol Rifle Operator
qualifications.description: Department-issued patrol rifle qualification covering manipulation, zeroing, transitions, and use of force application.

qualifications.name: Emergency Vehicle Operations (EVOC)
qualifications.description: Initial and refresher emergency vehicle operations training including pursuit driving, precision maneuvers, and response code policies.

qualifications.name: Crisis Intervention Team (CIT)
qualifications.description: 40-hour Memphis Model Crisis Intervention Team training for response to mental health and behavioral health crises.

qualifications.name: Taser / CEW Operator
qualifications.description: Annual conducted electrical weapon (CEW) operator certification including device operations, deployment guidelines, and reporting requirements.

qualifications.name: SWAT Operator Course
qualifications.description: Selection and basic SWAT operator training in close quarters battle, dynamic entry, breaching, and team movement.

forms.name: Use of Force Report
forms.description: Required documentation any time a sworn member uses force above unresisted handcuffing, displays a weapon, or deploys less-lethal or lethal options.
forms.instructions:
Submit prior to end of shift unless the involved officer is the subject of a critical incident review. Include narrative, force factors articulation, and BWC review references.

All reports are reviewed by the chain of command and the Use of Force Review Board.
forms.success_message: Use of Force Report submitted. The report has been routed to your immediate supervisor and the UoF Review Board.

fields.name: Narrative & Force Factors
fields.help: Articulate the totality of circumstances under Graham v. Connor, including subject behavior, severity of crime, and immediate threat assessment.

forms.name: Vehicle Pursuit Report
forms.description: Required documentation following any vehicle pursuit, terminated or otherwise, in accordance with General Order 215.
forms.instructions: Submit prior to end of shift. Pursuits resulting in collision, injury, or property damage will be reviewed by the Pursuit Review Board within 30 days.
forms.success_message: Pursuit Report submitted. A supervisor will follow up to complete the review process.

fields.name: Pursuit Narrative
fields.help: Include speeds, distance, weather, road conditions, traffic, supervisor notification, and tactics employed.

forms.name: Personnel Action Request
forms.description: Request changes to assignment, shift, classification, or other personnel actions.
forms.instructions:
Submit at least 14 days prior to the desired effective date. Routing:

1. Member completes the request below.
2. Immediate supervisor endorses.
3. Bureau commander reviews and forwards to the Office of the Chief.
forms.success_message: Personnel Action Request submitted and routed to your immediate supervisor.

forms.name: Training Course Request
forms.description: Request approval and funding to attend an external training course, conference, or instructor development.
forms.instructions: Submit at least 30 days prior to the course start date. Include course flyer, cost breakdown, and a written justification of how the training supports current and future job duties.
forms.success_message: Training request submitted to the Training Bureau for review.

fields.name: Estimated Total Cost
fields.help: Include tuition, lodging, per diem, and travel.

fields.name: Justification
fields.help: Explain how this training supports current duties, professional development, or department initiatives.

forms.name: Recruit / Lateral Application
forms.description: Apply to join the department as a recruit officer, lateral transfer, or returning sworn member.
forms.instructions: Applicants must be at least 21 years of age, possess a valid driver's license, and be free from any disqualifying criminal history. Lateral applicants must hold a current state POST certification in good standing.
forms.success_message: Thank you for your interest in joining our department. The recruitment unit will review your application and contact you regarding next steps.

fields.name: Prior Sworn Service
fields.help: List previous agencies, dates of service, and assignments. Leave blank if non-certified.

fields.name: Why do you want to be a police officer?
